clips.name: micromobility
clips.prompt: Photorealistic Japanese mobility-service website film, 10 seconds, silent, 16:9, calm clear daylight. One continuous medium-wide side-angle documentary shot OUTSIDE a small modern Japanese suburban railway station, in its open-air station forecourt. The station entrance facade is far behind; this is ground-level exterior, absolutely no platform, trains or rails visible. A dedicated marked scooter-share parking port is set into an asphalt bay. Three realistic unbranded electric STANDING KICK SCOOTERS have narrow foot decks, one straight steering stem, handlebar, two small wheels, no seats and NO PEDALS. The port connects directly to a visibly separate green painted cycle/micromobility path divided from all road traffic and pedestrian space by low planting beds. Keep geometry stable and clear. One adult wearing casual cream jacket and dark trousers, with a simple open-face ventilated bicycle helmet sitting on TOP of the head and a visible chin strap, face fully visible, NO visor and NO full-face motorcycle helmet. The adult stands beside the nearest scooter. First 0–3 seconds: the scooter remains stopped in port while they hold smartphone and tap once to unlock it. 3–5 seconds: they put smartphone completely into jacket pocket; both hands then grip handlebars, glance along the empty path. 5–10 seconds: one foot is firmly placed on the foot deck, the other gently pushes once from the ground, then BOTH FEET stand on the deck as the scooter rolls forward slowly onto the unobstructed dedicated cycle path, facing direction of travel. Camera gently tracks sideways while maintaining the rider, complete scooter and station exterior in view. Natural, physically correct movement and wheel rotation; rider always holds both handlebars while moving. No pedestrians on riding path, no crowded sidewalk, no car conflict. No phone in hand while riding, no pedals, no text, no logos, no watermarks. Fresh standalone scene, grounded and premium.

scenes.title: Considerate carshare user cleans after use
scenes.prompt: A single continuous 10-second premium naturalistic Japanese corporate documentary shot, present-day Japan. A considerate adult Japanese carshare user in casual cream overshirt, muted green top and ordinary trousers stands at an orderly Japanese carshare return parking space beside an unbranded shared white compact car, safely parked and completely stationary, engine off. The front passenger door is already open. This person is the customer who just finished using the shared car, not an employee, not a uniformed cleaner, with their own small everyday tote bag at their feet. They lean gently into the passenger cabin and use their own clearly visible clean light blue microfiber cloth in their right hand to carefully wipe the passenger seat and interior door touchpoint. Then, keeping the cloth in that hand, they pick up their own single small plain paper cup from the seat using their left hand and withdraw with it, finally glance back at the now neat seat with a subtle satisfied considerate expression. The cloth and cup remain physically continuous throughout; the cup is present from the beginning and stays visible in the left hand after pickup. The action communicates leaving a shared car pleasant for the next user. Medium side view framed through the open passenger doorway shows the casual user, seat, cloth and simple cleaning action clearly. Subtle smooth camera movement, soft morning daylight, restrained natural green and white palette, warm skin tones, realistic Japanese setting, natural face and hands. No spills or mess, no spray chemicals, no uniform, no logos, no readable text, no watermark. Silent footage.
